value.rationale: The two canonical distribution-free two-sample tests have exactly zero linear covariance by reversal, but a nonzero and strictly negative coupling for the two-sided squared rank sum. The exact finite-sample effect and fully position-resolved local profile explain how rank interleaving relates to a two-sided rank-sum departure. This informs dependence and calibration of complementary classical diagnostics, without claiming a new combined-testing procedure.
